Cell.Data: 你想不想知道为什么我这么伟大？
Do you want me to tell you why I'm great?
因为我有一条长长的，巨大的，茂密的胡子！
I have a great, big, bushy beard!
我的长袍是用真正的天鹅绒制作的。
My robes are made of real velour.
我的房间是整个城堡里最大的。
My room is the biggest in this castle.
我严格遵守制度，从未出过城堡一步。
I'm so dedicated to the Order I've actually never left this castle.
这就是为什么我很伟大！
早上好，我是这所学院的高级魔导师#Her_Vlad;， 不是吸血鬼弗拉德。[P=1] 你被选中前往#Location_HV;，协助#Her_King;保卫伟大的首都。

Good Morning. I am the senior tutor of the university -- #Her_Vlad; -- and I am not a vampire.[P=1] You have been chosen to travel to #Location_HV; and aid #Her_King; in the defence of the great capital city.
在你出发之前先给你一个简报：[P=2] #Boss_N07;已被放逐。[P=0.5] 怪物在大陆中游荡。[P=0.5] #Her_King;非常需要你的帮助！[P=0.5] 我是#Her_Vlad;, 不是吸血鬼弗拉德。[P=0.5] 你必须前往#Location_HV;。

So, a quick briefing before you go: [P=2] -#Boss_N07; is gone. [P=0.5] -Monsters roaming the lands. [P=0.5] -#Her_King; in need of your aid! [P=0.5] -I am #Her_Vlad;, not a vampire. [P=0.5] -You must go to #Location_HV;.
就是现盐盐盐在！ 到#Location_HV;去，#Her_King;急需你的帮助！
I meant NOOOOOW! Go to #Location_HV;, #Her_King; is in need of your aid!
我很想喝掉这碗汤，但是……[P=1] 没有勺！
I really want to eat this soup, but…[P=1] There's no spoon!
你好啊！楼下的那些人为你准备了 一个主题为“拯救世界”的欢送派对！ 你最好在他们吃完所有的奶酪之前赶过去。
Hi there! The guys downstairs have thrown a "saving the world" party for you. You should really hurry down there before they eat all the cheese.
在这里？恩，这里真的什么看头都没有， 只有性情暴躁而又讨厌派对的老巫师们[P=1]……和我。
Up here? Well, there's really nothing to see here, other than some grumpy old wizards who hate parties.[P=1].. And me.
在你去楼下之前，让我读一下这个给你听[P=1] “汝若湿身，切莫沾电”。
Before you go downstairs, let me read this to you[P=1] "Be thee wet, thy shall not dabble withe electricity"
多震惊啊！哈哈！[P=1] 是是，我知道，这东西的确很糟糕。抱歉……
How shocking! HAHA! [P=1] Yes, I know, that was terrible. Sorry...
我喜欢呆在这里。看看这风景！ 我连我的房子都能看见！[P=1]哦等一下……
I like hangin' out here. Look at the view! I can even see my house![P=1] Oh wait...
嘿！你看上去似乎迷上了COSPLAY！
LARP = live action role playing. You can sometimes find these types on university campuses, getting very very into role-playing games.
Hey! You look like you're into LARP!
一起来角色扮演吧！ 我只需要穿上我的长袍和戴我的巫师帽。
Let's roleplay! I'll just put on my robe and my wizard's hat.
I cast Level 3 Nerdbane. Now get thee hence!
真烦人……[P=1] 你还在这儿。
#Her_Vlad;是一个很伟大的人。 起初我还以为他是一只吸血鬼… [P=.5]但后来他使我相信了他其实并是不吸血鬼。
#Her_Vlad; is such a great man. At first I thought he was a vampire... [P=.5]But then he assured me that he wasn't.
#Her_HM;是一个真正的伟大人物。 起初我还以为他只是个有胡须的魔法使， 此外什么都不是…[P=0.5]但后来他告诉我他确实是伟大的人物。
The joke has been altered. A wizard-student talking about the Headmaster
#Her_HM; is truly a great man. At first I thought he was nothing but a wizard with a beard…[P=0.5] But then he told me he was.
天哪，我还有很多要学的。
Boy do I have a lot to learn.
哦，你好啊！我已经有一段时间在这里没有见到任何人了。[P=.5] 我不认为这地方有任何楼梯。我也没指望找到一个……
Oh, hello there! I haven't seen anyone around here in a while.[P=.5] I don't think this place has any stairs. None that I've managed to find anyway.
听起来他们似乎有个派对…… 我觉得我还是读我的书吧。
Sounds Like they're having a party... I think I'll just read a book instead.
你是谁？实际上，我不在乎，当我没问……
in this passage, one NPC speaks, and his nearby friend always adds a comment.
Who are you? Actually, I don't care, never mind...
我该不该在你走之前告诉你个秘密？
Do I have to tell you a secret before you'll go away?
好，这里有一个关于你的秘密：
Okay, so here's a secret for you:
我以前拯救世界的时候，用了很多栅栏。 它们把敌人阻挡在海湾边时很管用！
Back when I saved the world, I used a lot of Barriers. They're a really powerful way of keeping foes at bay!
当#Boss_N07;被勒令驱逐，他最信任的随从也离开了。
When #Boss_N07; was banished from the Order, his most trusted followers left as well.
如果你在那儿遇见他们的话…[P=1] 代我问声好！
If you meet any of them out there...[P=1] Tell them I said hello!
So you're going to save the world huh?
我很愿意帮你一把，但是，恩… [P=1]我在5点的时候…[P=1.5] 有件事要办…所以…
I'd love to go with you, but um...[P=1] I have this thing...[P=1.5] at 5:00... so...
哦，看啊，是华丽丽的长袍英雄们。
Oh, look, it's the fancy robed heroes.
你认为你能做到？你真的认为你能做到？
You think you can do it? You really think you can do it?
我只是在和你开玩笑，你当然能做到。
I'm just playing with you; of course you can do it.
这些家伙不喜欢水，这真是太好了。
These guys don't like water, but I think it's great.
你要知道如，果你同时使用 水 和 雪 就会得到 冰。我还听说了个方法可以制造 蒸汽，但我从来都没有领悟到底怎样搞。
You know, if you mix WATER and COLD you get ICE. I've also heard there's some way to create steam, but I never figured out how though.
额…派对早就开始了，而且奶酪似乎快被吃光了… [P=1]不过没啥好担心的，#WizN1;快去东边的塔再拿一点来！
Ehm… We already started the party and I'm afraid we're almost out of cheese… [P=1]Don't be upset! #WizN1; went to the eastern tower to get some more!
你在下面没事儿吧！？[P=1.5] 你再找一条路离开地牢吧， 我们要赶紧把这块地板修好！
the heroes fell through the floor, into the dungeon below. and the other wizards are "helpfully" boarding up the broken floor.
ARE YOU ALL RIGHT DOWN THERE!?[P=1.5] … You just try to find the way out of the dungeon, while we board this up!
Remember:[P=1] the safe word is BANANA!
哇，你做到了！ 我们派#Boss_N16;下去找你了。[P=1]你知道的， 我们的宠物，可爱的名叫瞧瞧的大眼睛怪。
Wow, you made it! We sent #Boss_N16; down to look for you.[P=1] You know, our pet watcher.
我猜你没遇见它。不过算了…[P=.5] 考虑到#WizN12;的魔法失误，你最好学会这个： #Ent_Magick; 吐出了很多魔法技能书。
I guess you must have missed him. Anyway...[P=.5] Considering #WizN12;'s miscast, it's probably for the best if you had this #Ent_Magick;.
也许在我们触发更多的“意外”之前， 你离开了反而是件好事。
Maybe it's best you leave before we have any more "accidents".
哇喔，看看我！我是“#Boss_N07;”，我发明了一个犀利的魔法！
Wooh, look at me! I'm #Boss_N07;, and I invent Magicks.
我想知道那扇门后面有什么…
I wonder what's behind that door...
我猜我永远都找不到了。
I guess I'll never find out.
现在那道门消失了，我心里却一阵空虚。
the player has blasted open the door
Now that the door is gone, I feel kind of empty inside.
哈，又年轻了！我还记得上次我拯救了这个世界。 毫不夸张的说，这可真让人兴奋！
Ah, to be young again! I remember the last time I saved the world. It was exciting to say the least.
是的，尽管 第一次 更让人兴奋。
Yes. The first time was even more exciting though.
不！第二次 更好！我们都同意的！
No! The second was better! We all agreed!
第二次？！那次一点都不兴奋！
The second?! It was barely exciting at all!
你根本不知道你在说什么！
You don't know what you're talking about!
我们就不能各自回忆自个儿的吗？
Can't we all just agree to disagree?
好吧，不管怎么样，有一件事确定了：[P=1] 他们不再像过去那样做电脑游戏了！
Well, anyway, one thing is for sure:[P=1] They don't make computer games like they used to!
Similar sounding to the above line
…只有哥布林射手能如此精准。
哦，是你啊。你该向北走。 不过光是看它的样子， 你就该明白得小心那些哥布林。
Oh, it's you. You should be on your way northward. By the looks of it, you'll have to watch out for goblins.
吼吼吼！看！崭新的长袍！值钱！拿到它们！
RAKANISHLOL! Look! Shiny robes! Gets them!
我肯定我先前就见过那个巨魔。
I sure showed that troll earlier.
你是认真的吗？你只是扔了块石头过去 然后比范跑跑跑得还快！
Are you serious? You just threw a rock at it, and ran away as fast as you could.
嘿！没有什么比巨魔看中你的菊花更……
Cut sentence because wizards walk by. Original sentence: Hey! It doesn't get any more serious than a troll about to charge your ass.
Hey! It doesn't get any more serious than a troll about to charge your --
哦你好！将军在里面等着你。
Oh hello! The captain is waiting for you inside.
啊，你好！我是#Her_bjorn;， 一个勇士。我们一路从……
Ah, greetings! I am #Her_bjorn; the Brave. We have marched all the way from --
我的上帝呀！一个森林巨魔！
Good god man! A forest troll!
哦感谢你的帮助！原来你还是有那么一点用处的。
Thanks for the assistance! You might actually be of some use after all.
我们被国王从#Location_HV;派来接应你， 不过就我看来，你自己一路闯过去完全没问题。
I was sent here to escort you to #Location_HV; where #Her_King; awaits. But from what I've seen, you'll probably be all right on your own.
所以…你继续走吧…我们就呆在这。 呃，你可以带上我的斧头，如果能它让你好感觉好些的话。
So… you just go ahead and... we'll stay here. Uhh, if it makes you feel any better, you can borrow my axe.
还有什么事？门就在那，赶紧过去吧， #Location_HV;就在北边的…呃不远处。
What's the matter? The gate is right there, just go through it and #Location_HV; is straight ahead to the north... more or less...
我错过了吗？我错过战斗了吗？
Have I missed it? Have I missed the battle?
噢不！将军已经阵亡了! 你必须前往#Location_HV;。 只要从东门出去并沿着北方的小路前进！走！
Oh no! The Captain has fallen! You must go to #Location_HV;. Just go through the EAST gate and follow the road north! Go!
一个穿着黑斗篷的男人咬了我！
in the wizard castle, you can find a character lying in the shadows. He has apparently been bitten by a vampire! (Vlad of course)
A man in a black cloak bit me!
我觉得有点恶心…我觉得我得躺一会。
I'm feeling a little woozy... I think I'll just lie down for a while
你介不介意帮我告诉#Her_bjorn; ，那个，我，我午饭后就来？
he's going to take a nap, he'll be back later.
Would you mind telling #Her_bjorn; that I'll be back after lunch today?
嗨？你看起来有点像巫师！ 我的地下室里鼠患横行，希望你能帮我清理清理。 我没法给你太多，但还是能付几个银币的。
Hello? You look like some sort of wizard! I have this nasty rat infestation in my cellar. I don't have much to offer you, but I guess I could spare a couple of coins.
谢谢你！我地下室里的鼠患看起来没有那么糟了。[P=1] 不管怎么说我很乐意给你这几个银币，但你可能没处花… [P=.5]唉，总之很悲催啊。
After the "mission" is assigned, goblins appear. In fact, the rats are never dealt with. After the goblin encounter, the villager is no longer so concerned about the rats.

Thank you! Suddenly the rats in my cellar don't seem so bad after all. [P=1] I'd be happy to give you the coins anyhow, but there doesn't seem to be a proper inventory in this game.[P=.5] Ah, well, tough luck.
要是我能摆脱这个一直杵在我头顶的感叹号就好了…
a joke about RPG games with missions. A "!" is above the character, indicating that she has something important to say. Now that the mission is over, the "!" should disappear, but it doesn't.
Now if only I could get rid of this exclamation mark that's been following me around lately...
我每天早上都到这里来用魔法，这样说不定有一天我也能拯救世界。
I come here every morning to do some spellcasting so that I too may one day have the honor of saving the world.
我觉得我总有一天能打败这些靶子人偶！
he's doing the wizard's form of archery practice
I think I'll be able to knock these target-dolls down someday!
天呐？！我的人偶们！你做了些什么！？ 我以后该怎么办？
Wha!? My target dolls! What have you done!? What am I going to do now?
我已经把你传送回过去的[P=1]#Location_WC;。 呃，有些事情……算了以后再说。 你现在的所处的时间略落后于过去出发的自己。
Adventure Time Ref. & Flight of the conchords ref.
I have sent you back in time...[P=1] and to #Location_WC;. I, however, remain in the future -- so you are way behind.
看起来#Boss_N07;已经被来自虚空领域的大恶魔控制， 一个被称为#Boss_N15;的恐怖的存在。 这情况比我一开始预料的还要可怕， 更糟的是，我现在这种跨时空的状态，力量被大大限制了！

It seems that #Boss_N07; has been possessed by a daemon from the ethereal realm, a terrible being known as #Boss_N15;. The situation is more dire than I first suspected, and to make things worse, my power in the past is very limited.

It seems that #Boss_N07; has been possessed by a daemon from the ethereal realm, a terrible being known as #Boss_N15;. The situation is more dire than I first suspected, and to make things worse, my power in the past is very limited.
拯救世界的唯一希望是把#Boss_N15;转化到现实世界， 那样他才能被打败。你必须再次向北前进， 找到并说服伟大的#Boss_N14;教你古老的魔法： #magick_corporealize;。

The only hope of saving the world is to draw #Boss_N15; into the material realm, where he can be defeated. You must go north once more, and convince the great #Boss_N14; to teach you the ancient magick #magick_corporealize;.

The only hope of saving the world is to draw #Boss_N15; into the material realm, where he can be defeated. You must go north once more, and convince the great #Boss_N14; to teach you the ancient magick #magick_corporealize;.
又来了一拨巫师？只是路过吗？好吧，那我就不用 向你解释拔出门闩又插回去有多困难了吧…那么……
More wizards? Just passing through? Well, I don't have to explain to you how much of a hassle it would be to unbar the gate and then nail it back up… so…
More wizards? Just passing through? Well, I don't have to explain to you how much of a hassle it would be to unbar the gate and then nail it back up… so…
#Boss_n14;？没听说过。但如果你要向北走的话， 你只需通过已经被遗弃的#location_mi;。
#Boss_n14;? Never heard of it. But if you're going north you could just as well travel through the abandoned #location_mi;.
#Boss_n14;? Never heard of it. But if you're going north you could just as well travel through the abandoned #location_mi;.
去吧……至少它像东边的小路一样安全。
Go on then... It's at least as safe as the eastern road.
Go on then... It's at least as safe as the eastern road.
我忽悠了那些巫师，说#location_mi;已经 被废弃并非常安全。
I lied -- told them that #location_mi; was abandoned and perfectly safe.
I lied -- told them that #location_mi; was abandoned and perfectly safe.
哦好吧…无所谓，[P=2]反正，这是最后一次见到他们了。
Oh… [P=2]Well, that's the last we'll be seeing of them!
Oh… [P=2]Well, that's the last we'll be seeing of them!
倒霉的#WizN1;。他并没完全解决起司的问题 但至少他好像为自己找到了#Ent_Magick;。
Poor #WizN1;. He didn't quite manage to solve the cheese problem – but at least he found himself some kind of #Ent_Magick;.
桥断了…而且…巫师们都是旱鸭子。
The bridge is broken… And… Wizards can't swim…
The bridge is broken… And… Wizards can't swim…
有一种飞艇它是这样飞的…

there is a project management system in software development known as SCRUM. Work on a project is divided into weekly "sprints". At the beginning of the game, where Vlad is "teaching" the players in the classroom, there is a SCRUM board behind him. The player can look at the chalkboard and see this joke. It means that the sprint isn't working very well for some reason. it's "going down the drain" = "going poorly, and getting worse"
This sprint is really going down the drain…
像往常一样，只有垃圾邮件。
the wizards check the post box outside the castle
on the table is also a lot of sausage
HerN11="Headmaster", not to be confused with HerN1="The Headmaster" (with article)
#WizN1;他可真是[P=1] 一个足智多谋的巫师！
Baelyg (sp?), the guy who is trying to invent a cheeze magick, for creating cheeze.
It's #WizN1;.[P=1] One of the most resourceful wizards of the order!
现在，离开#Location_WC;吧。 欢迎下次光临！
你没必要这么做，不过烧掉绳子也不是个坏主意。
You don't have to, but it wouldn't be a bad idea to burn the rope.
You don't have to, but it wouldn't be a bad idea to burn the rope.
